# Mr-Agents Full-Stack Web & UI/UX Engineering Pack (`webdev-pack`)

> **Pack Overview:** Consolidates **28 production-grade skills** from the `Mr-Agents` universal catalog into a single installable pack skill.
> **Focus Area:** End-to-end web, mobile, and game development, Tailwind CSS design systems, GSAP animations, REST/GraphQL API design, WCAG accessibility, Core Web Vitals performance, and UI/UX polish.

## When to Activate This Pack

Use when designing, building, styling, animating, auditing, or optimizing websites, web apps, mobile apps, APIs, design systems, or interactive browser experiences.

## Core Execution Playbook

1. **Architecture & Tokens First**: Establish clean component hierarchy, responsive layout tokens (Tailwind/CSS variables), and typed API contracts before writing feature code.
2. **Craft & Accessibility**: Enforce WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation, semantic HTML, and purposeful motion (GSAP/CSS transitions).
3. **Verify & Optimize**: Check Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), bundle size, runtime console errors, and responsive breakpoints before completion.

## Detailed Skill Playbooks & Directives

When executing a task matching one of the included skills below, apply its specific workflow:

### `accessibility`
- **Trigger & Scope:** Audit and improve web accessibility following WCAG 2.2 guidelines. Use when asked to "improve accessibility", "a11y audit", "WCAG compliance", "screen reader support", "keyboard navigation", or "make accessible".
- **Key Workflow Sections:** Evidence-led audit workflow → WCAG Principles: POUR → Conformance levels → Perceivable → Text alternatives (1.1) → Color contrast (1.4.3, 1.4.6)
- **Core Directive:** Comprehensive accessibility guidelines based on WCAG 2.2 and Lighthouse accessibility audits. Goal: make content usable by everyone, including people with disabilities.
- **Canonical Skill Path:** `dist/skills/accessibility/SKILL.md` (or install individually via `npx --yes github:arz282-ctrl/Mr-Agents install accessibility`)
